customSections.label: BCSD Schedule Changes Families Should Know
customSections.content: BCSD's calendar includes eight two-hour delayed starts, four minimum days, two conference windows, and two reserved attendance days. Most affect arrival or dismissal times; May 27–28 are used only if additional attendance days are needed.

groups.label: Two-hour delayed starts
items: BCSD says all schools start two hours later; morning buses run two hours later, breakfast is served, and dismissal times stay the same.

groups.label: Minimum days
items: March 19 and May 26, 2027; May 26 is also the last scheduled student day.

groups.label: Wednesday Bank Day schedules
items: BCSD's 2026–27 bell schedules include Wednesday Bank Day dismissal times for each campus. Many schools dismiss earlier than on a regular day, so families should check the listed time for their school.

groups.label: Reserved attendance days
items: BCSD reserves May 27–28, 2027, only if additional attendance days are needed. They are excluded from the default ICS file.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Bakersfield City School District start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school was Wednesday, August 12, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is BCSD Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. Students return Monday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is BCSD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs March 22–26, 2027. March 29 is also a holiday in lieu of Admission Day, and students return Tuesday, March 30.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for BCSD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last scheduled student day is Wednesday, May 26, 2027, and it is a minimum day. May 27–28 are reserved attendance days that apply only if BCSD needs them.

calendarFaqs.q: What are the BCSD two-hour delayed-start dates?
calendarFaqs.a: The delayed starts are September 10, October 15, November 19, and December 10, 2026, plus January 14, February 25, March 11, and May 13, 2027. BCSD says schools and morning buses start two hours later, while dismissal times remain unchanged.

calendarFaqs.q: Which days are minimum days for BCSD students?
calendarFaqs.a: The minimum days are November 20 and December 18, 2026, and March 19 and May 26, 2027.
The district calendar lists conference windows on October 19–23, 2026, and March 30–April 2, 2027. Check the student's school for appointment and bell-schedule details.

calendarFaqs.q: Does BCSD publish a Spanish 2026–27 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The official BCSD PDF includes both English and Spanish calendar pages.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2025–26
whatsNew.subtitle: Four schedule differences from the previous BCSD calendar.
content: The school year starts August 12 instead of August 13.
Thanksgiving Recess begins November 23 instead of November 24.
Spring Break moves from March 30–April 3 in 2025–26 to March 22–26 in 2026–27.
The last scheduled student day moves from May 29 to May 26.

sourceReviewSummary: BCSD's official calendar page was checked August 17, 2026. It still links the same 2026–27 Drive file used for the date review on this page.
sourceReviewDetails: The student dates, breaks, delayed starts, minimum days, conference windows, reporting dates, and reserved attendance days were reviewed from BCSD's bilingual 2026–27 calendar.
Purely administrative duty dates for principals and office staff are omitted from the student calendar table because they do not change student attendance.
BCSD's Late Start Days page corroborates the eight delayed-start Thursdays and says morning buses run two hours later, breakfast is served, and dismissal times remain the same.
The BCSD Late Start Days page lists January 14, 2026. The 2026–27 district calendar lists the January delayed start on January 14, 2027, so that is the date used here.
BCSD's 2026–27 bell schedules list campus-specific Wednesday Bank Day dismissal times; many schools dismiss earlier than on a regular day.
May 27–28 are reserved attendance days that apply only if needed and are excluded from the default ICS file.
